column1: # F14 (u5-engine#47): a party loaded with every member asleep (status 'S'),
# then left alone. Measures whether, when and how the stock wakes it - turn
# count, hour, random roll or a key - for cleak/u5-spec#299 Q23. The first
# three minutes send no key at all; Space (Pass) presses follow after that.
# Measured 2026-10-19: the stock party wakes within a few passes (Space then
# echoes `Pass`), but the panel keeps showing every member `S` - the town wake
# The town arm passes the turn, so the post-action wake roll (1 in 16 per
# sleeper) runs after each sleep row and the number of sleep rows printed
# before the party wakes is a draw: the rc3 sweep (20261020-013403) had the
# stock wake after three and the engine after five, and every beat still
# showing those rows differed by that count alone. The declaration below
# compares those beats with the leading blank rows dropped and a repeated
# `marker, sleep row, blank` unit folded into one, so the draw does not count
# while the shape of each pass, the `Pass` echoes after the wake (and how many
# there are) and the roster panel - every member still `S` after the wake -
# sleep-count-beats: arrival idle1 idle2 idle3 idle4 idle5 idle6 idle7 idle8 idle9 pass1 pass2 pass3 pass4 pass5 pass6 pass7 pass8 pass9 pass10 pass11 pass12
# requires-seed: the party in Britain with every active member's status Sleeping
